verdicts.reason: Both break the design apart into scattered parts. In A, the two food photos shrink to tiny thumbnails inside the beige and pattern squares, the decorative frame is empty, the divider is blown up, and Cascadia, RESTAURANT and the URL are spread along the bottom edge with a lot of dead space. B also lays every element out in a row (beige block, empty frames, frame ornament, plate drawing), drops a large orphaned pattern block in the corner and splits the brand text apart. B is still a little less bad because its two pasta photos are at least visible.
